research_rationale:
EO 10955 (31 July 1961) has two operative sections: sec. 1 delegates to the Secretary of State the functions conferred on the President by sections 2 and 3 of the Act of September 8, 1960 (Latin America development and reconstruction of Chile), and sec. 2 deems the funds appropriated under those sections allocated to the Secretary of State. The held original (26 FR 6967, jobs/fr-originals text) was read in full for these two sections; the dossier inventory listed only sec. 2 and is corrected to sec. 1 and sec. 2. Later EO 10973 (3 November 1961; 26 FR 10469; official FR text layer) sec. 605(c) lists EO 10955 among orders that "are hereby superseded", and sec. 607 makes that order effective as of September 30, 1961. EO 10973 sec. 101 itself delegates to the Secretary of State the functions under the Latin America act, so the command moved into the new order. Status: no. First end 1961-09-30 by express supersession (effective date from sec. 607, not the signing date of November 3, 1961).

savings.reason: EO 10973 sec. 606 saves determinations, authorizations and other actions made with respect to any function affected by that order and not revoked before its date, to continue until amended, modified or terminated; the delegated functions themselves continue under EO 10973 sec. 101. The surviving effect is therefore carried by EO 10973, not by EO 10955, and no independent EO 10955 command remains.
